reasoning:
• Growth Z (+0.79) and inflation Z (+0.88) confirm above-trend output and above-target price pressures.
• Clockwise progression places the economy in Overheat, advancing toward the late-cycle Stagflation boundary.
• Resilient 5.1% GDPNow growth and 3.34% Core PCE prompted the Fed's first rate hike to 3.75%–4.00%.
• Decisive rotation out of Recovery cements cyclical transition as stubborn wholesale PPI reaches 5.44%.
outlook:
• Baseline (55%): Economy remains in late Overheat with one additional Fed hike expected.
• Stagflation risk (35%): Sustained $100+ crude oil and 5.00%+ Treasury yields choke economic growth.
• Watchlist: November FOMC rate decision and September PPI/CPI releases for margin compression.
key_indicators: Core PCE 3.34% YoY — Remains 134 bps above target, anchoring positive inflation Z-score.
PPI Final Demand 5.44% YoY — Surging wholesale pipeline inflation signals persistent input cost pressures.
Atlanta Fed GDPNow 5.1% SAAR — Robust consumer spending confirms strong above-trend economic expansion.
Initial Jobless Claims 201k — Multi-month low confirms exceptional labor retention and tight capacity.
10-Year Treasury Yield 5.01% — Expanding term premium reflects stubborn inflation and tighter monetary policy.
risks: Oil price spike — Brent topping $120/bbl accelerates rotation into Stagflation.
Fed overtightening — 5.00%+ Treasury yields trigger credit stress and capital spending cuts.
Tariff frictions — Section 122 duties raise input costs without generating real output.
gemini_research_summary: Surging 5.1% GDPNow growth alongside 3.34% Core PCE and $100+ oil prompted a 25 bps Fed rate hike, cementing the rotation into Overheat.

monitoring_triggers.meaning: Heightens stagflation risk by taxing consumer discretionary spending
Signals labor market deterioration and growth deceleration
Intensifies corporate debt-servicing stress and credit tightening

Supported by domestic manufacturing investment, infrastructure modernization, and expanding defense order books.
